color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Visitor
[Person]
Unauthenticated user. Browses jobs and companies,
registers, logs in, resets a password

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Applicant
[Person]
Registered job seeker. Applies with a resume,
tracks and withdraws applications, edits profile

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Company (Recruiter)
[Person]
Registered employer. Posts and manages jobs,
reviews candidates, updates their status

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Admin
[Person]
Platform administrator created by the seed script.
Moderates users, companies and job posts

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
JobPortal BD Web Application
[Software System]
React SPA + Node.js/Express REST API + MongoDB.
Connects applicants with companies

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Gmail SMTP
[External System]
Delivers OTP e-mails
(verification and password reset)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cloudinary
[External System]
Stores profile photos, company logos
and applicant resumes

svg.text: C4 Level 1 - System Context: JobPortal BD
